title: Polly Parrot
hook: Peppa 一家去看爷爷奶奶，奶奶家多了一位会学人说话的新成员——鹦鹉 Polly。

cells.a: They were going to visit Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig.
cells.cn: 他们去看猪奶奶和猪爷爷。

cells.q: What did Granny ask Peppa to do?
cells.a: She asked Peppa to guess what the new pet was.
cells.cn: 她让 Peppa 猜猜新宠物是什么。

cells.a: Because that is what parrots do. They copy words.
cells.cn: 因为鹦鹉就是这样，会学人说话。

cells.q: What did Mummy Pig say about Polly?
cells.a: She said, “What a sweet little parrot!”
cells.cn: 她说：“多可爱的小鹦鹉啊！”

cells.q: What do Peppa and George love eating?
cells.a: They love eating chocolate cake at Granny's house.
cells.cn: 他们最爱在奶奶家吃巧克力蛋糕。

cells.a: She asked to leave the table and see Polly Parrot.
cells.cn: 她问能不能离开餐桌去看 Polly。

cells.a: They were really enjoying playing with Polly Parrot.
cells.cn: 他们和 Polly 玩得特别开心。

cells.a: She was thinking of something else to say to Polly.
cells.cn: 她在想还能对 Polly 说点什么。

cells.q: What did Polly say at the end?
cells.a: She said, “I'm a clever parrot!” and everyone laughed.
cells.cn: 她说：“我是只聪明的鹦鹉！”大家都笑了。
